title: fwreskip G1: open a QuickTime recording window for the iPhone
instructions: On the Mac open QuickTime Player > File > New Movie Recording (allow camera access if asked). Click the small arrow next to the red record button: Camera = the iPhone, Quality = Maximum. Leave the window open and do NOT press record; we start and stop it from a script. Keep the iPhone unlocked, plugged in and untouched for about 20 min. Press Done when the window shows the iPhone screen.

result.notes: I was decline the camera access that iTerm was request. We might to restart the iTerm for apply the new permission
